test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BLISS' is coded as 'MAITR' and 'JAPAN' is coded as 'BIPOZ'. How will 'GLOBE' be coded in that language?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is :

 'BLISS' is coded as 'MAITR' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8747396b2ab65493faffdc11aa513d69bd762a6cb25564b9d05c1942680261d.png] 

 'JAPAN' is coded as 'BIPOZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a264cee802aaf4086377050b7fd04add5ef9bdfd667ac243a23cc1ae6512aa.png] 

Similarly, 'GLOBE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3efb9873cbbe36d872e97bee1ad1247e6d17e2a2862e76d9867bf8c48a4e8c97.png] 

Hence, **"MFOFA"** is the correct answer.
